Class Movie

java.lang.Object
MediaEntry
Movie
public class Movie extends MediaEntry
Represents a single feature film in a MediaVault library. In addition to the attributes every media entry carries, a Movie records its director, its runtime in minutes, and the year it was released.

  • Constructor Details

    • Movie

      public Movie(String title, String genre, MediaStatus status, String director, int durationMinutes, int releaseYear)
      Constructs a new Movie with the given shared and movie-specific details.

      Precondition: durationMinutes and releaseYear are positive
      Postcondition: the Movie is created with no rating or review

      Parameters:
      title - the title of the movie
      genre - the genre of the movie
      status - the initial status of the movie
      director - the name of the movie's director
      durationMinutes - the runtime of the movie in minutes
      releaseYear - the year the movie was released
